title: Ensuring Development and Maintenance of Ethical Artificial Intelligence Standards
what_it_is: Ensuring Development and Maintenance of Ethical Artificial Intelligence Standards

sections.label: AI governance measures and guidelines
sections.summary: Singapore introduced AI governance measures, plans advisory guidelines, engages industry and international counterparts, and issued public service guidelines for AI use.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Among other measures, we introduced the Model AI Governance Framework and AI Verify, a self-testing toolkit to demonstrate responsible deployment of AI.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Later this year, we plan to issue the Advisory Guidelines on the Use of Personal Data in AI Systems under the Personal Data Protection Act.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: We regularly engage industry and international counterparts, such as through our Advisory Council on Ethical Use of AI and Data and the Global Partnership on Artificial Intelligence, to keep abreast of developments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Where necessary and useful, we will update our measures to take into account the impact of developments like Chat Generative Pre-trained Transformer (ChatGPT) and GPT-4.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: For example, the Public Service has introduced guidelines for public officers using similar technologies to draft documents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: These guidelines make clear that public officers are accountable for their work and are responsible for fact-checking and vetting AI-generated content.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: The guidelines also aim to safeguard data security by reminding officers not to input sensitive information into these applications.

sections.label: Private sector advisory council role
sections.summary: The private sector has significant representation on the Advisory Council on the Ethical Use of AI.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The role of the private sector is important.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We have significant representation from the private sector in our Advisory Council on the Ethical Use of AI.
